(b) devoted, considered, thought, contemplative, made effort; one. (c) devoted, fallen, settled in-fallen through attachment; one. (d) believed vey much, stood unshakingly. (e) believed-devoted extremely (grammatical). (2) (a) devoted, believed, decided, taken. established as a doctrine. (b) devoted, thought, contemplative; made to be Vipassanā (b) See Abhiniviṭṭhadomanassa.
